<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant monoisotopic peak with an ~8 % M+1 peak and much smaller higher‑order peaks—the intensities match the expected distribution for several 13C atoms and show no significant M+2 contributions that would indicate elements like Cl, Br, or S. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from this spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
